title: GPT Image 2.6 Guide: Features, Price and Prompts
summary: GPT Image 2.6 guide: what OpenAI's new image model does, what it costs in Flick, and real tests of Planning, transparent backgrounds, SVG and edits.
body_markdown:
### What is GPT Image 2.6?


GPT Image 2.6 is OpenAI's image generation and editing model, released on November 4, 2026, with a Planning control for dense text and layouts. In Flick it makes and edits images at 1K, 2K or 4K from a prompt and up to 10 reference images.


### How much does GPT Image 2.6 cost?


In Flick, GPT Image 2.6 costs 5 credits an image at its default Prompt Weight and 1K, and 10 at high weight. Planning, transparent backgrounds and SVG output add nothing.


### Is GPT Image 2.6 free?


GPT Image 2.6 runs on Flick's Free plan, and each image uses credits. A new Flick account gets 100 credits, enough for several GPT Image 2.6 images.


### What is GPT Image 2.6 Flare?


Flare is the fast version of GPT Image 2.6, made for quick drafts and iterations. In Flick it has the same settings and costs 5 credits at its defaults.


### Can GPT Image 2.6 make a transparent background?


Yes. Turn on Transparent Background and it returns the subject as a cutout PNG. Our film camera test came back with no background, ready to use as a prop.


### Can GPT Image 2.6 make an SVG?


Yes, from a prompt alone. Turn on SVG (Vector) and it returns a vector file. With a reference image or a Flickpedia style connected, it returns a PNG instead.


### Can GPT Image 2.6 make a GIF?


Yes. Generate GIF in Flick uses GPT Image 2.6 to animate a prompt or a connected image into a looping GIF of 4, 9 or 16 frames, for 14 credits at the default 9.
